1.consolidated_definition: Indica que la mujer domina en el hogar y retiene en él al marido. Variante: Tenerlo sentado en el baúl.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Indicates that the woman dominates in the home and retains her husband within it. Variant: To have him seated on the trunk (baúl).
